dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing from the widest mid-body section toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with a light-blue/grey tint consistent with submerged reflectance.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple faint, light-colored linear marks crossing the mid-dorsal region diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of faint diagonal rake marks across the mid-dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Centrally positioned, dark blowhole orifice visible at the anterior end.
